body: Fixes #7104 Summary • Exclude non-form-control element IDs from form submission payloads. • Prevent labels, validation messages, submit buttons, and other non-input descendants from appearing as  null  entries. • Preserve IDs for actual form controls. • Add regression coverage and a changelog fragment. Validation •  uv run pytest tests/units/components/forms/test_form.py -q  — 17 passed • Targeted pre-commit checks passed: Ruff format/check, codespell, Pyright, and ty •  git diff --check  passed
title: fix(forms): omit non-control ids from submissions
